hints.title: Distinct Character Comparison
hints.text: A split at index i is good if the count of distinct letters in s[0..i] equals the count of distinct letters in s[i+1..n-1].

hints.title: Prefix and Suffix Distinct Arrays
hints.text: Precompute prefix_distinct[i] as the number of unique characters up to index i, and suffix_distinct[i] from index i to the end.

hints.title: Count Matching Split Points
hints.text: Iterate i from 0 to n - 2, incrementing answer whenever prefix_distinct[i] equals suffix_distinct[i + 1].

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recomputing unique characters for both halves at every split point takes O(N^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Precalculating prefix and suffix distinct counts takes O(N) time and O(N) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate builds prefix/suffix tables or uses running frequency counters to evaluate splits in linear time.
complexity.notes: Can also be solved with O(26) space using two frequency maps.
